name: W Dallas Victory
positioning: W Dallas, a high-energy W hotel in Victory Park across the street from the American Airlines Center, with a 16th-floor infinity pool and spa, terrace suites and DJ-driven bars
best_for: Fans heading to a game or concert at the American Airlines Center
Friends and couples who want a rooftop pool scene, DJ sets and a lively bar
Travelers who want a terrace suite with skyline views

facts.text: W Dallas stands in Victory Park, a hub for entertainment, dining and culture.
The Perot Museum, the Katy Trail and the Arts District are steps away.
WET Deck is a rooftop space with skyline views.
The spa has a dry sauna, a steam shower and a relaxation lounge.
The spa offers contrast therapy, moving between the sauna and cold showers.
The W Suite has skyline views and a private terrace above Victory Park.
Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and Texas-rooted design.
All guest rooms have W signature bedding, smart TVs and Davines bath products.
The Living Room has double-dyed cowhide walls, sculptural furnishings and a chandelier.
The W Insider team can help plan and book Dallas activities.

highlights.text: The American Airlines Center arena is across the street from the hotel.
WET Deck includes an outdoor infinity pool on the 16th floor and a pool bar.
AWAY Spa is on the 16th floor with views of downtown and Victory Park.
The Penthouse has a private furnished terrace overlooking the American Airlines Center and the Dallas skyline.
Vinyl DJ sets play in the Living Room, and local DJs play rooftop afternoons by the pool.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel is upscale but anything but traditional in decor and vibe, so it may not suit fans of classic luxury.
Conde Nast Traveler says the WET Deck pool often has events that draw locals.
WhataHotel notes the urban party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
